description: The bar chart compares the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60, while the horizontal axis lists the difficulty levels. For each category, two bars are shown: a light blue bar for NatSQL and a dark blue bar for TA-SQL. In the Simple category, NatSQL achieves an accuracy of 60.21, while TA-SQL reaches 63.14. In the Moderate category, NatSQL scores 39.64, and TA-SQL scores 48.60. For the Challenging category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 32.32, and TA-SQL has 36.11. In the Total category, NatSQL's accuracy is 51.35, and TA-SQL's is 56.19. The chart indicates that TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL across all categories, with the largest difference observed in the Moderate category.
